name: Software structure
description: Structural norms generated for this workspace. Every obligation names a path detected in it.

obligationTemplates.title: No dependency cycle among source modules
obligationTemplates.repair: Break the cycle by moving the shared type or helper into a module both sides may depend on.

obligationTemplates.title: Every module import resolves within the declared source graph
obligationTemplates.repair: Fix or remove imports that do not resolve to a collected file — path aliases, bare package specifiers written as relative paths, and escapes from the detected root all leave a hole in the graph every other rule reads.

obligationTemplates.title: No module declares more function-like names than the responsibility ceiling allows
obligationTemplates.repair: Split packages modules that accumulate more than 20 declared names into narrower responsibilities.
